mandatoryCriteria: Add column: POST /api/v1/boards/:boardId/columns adds new column with name, color, category, expectedBoardVersion
Max 12 columns bound: Rejects column creation if board already has 12 columns with 400 or 422
Duplicate column name check: Rejects duplicate column names within the board (case-insensitive, trimmed) with 400 or 409
Rename and edit column: PATCH /api/v1/boards/:boardId/columns/:columnId updates name, color, category with expectedBoardVersion; rejects duplicate name
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Column addition and renaming with 12 column limit and name uniqueness.
